{{Quote|That botched dolfrimia run-remember? You said, 'It'll be fine; don't worry about it.|Han reminds Lando of a run they made smuggling dolfrimia|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Dolfrimia''' was a trade good available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the life of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Solo and his friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once botched a smuggling run from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boordii]] in which they were transporting dolfrimia. Calrissian had assured Solo the run would go fine prior to its failure, a fact Solo would later remind Calrissian of.
